errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are sorted from the lowest to the highest percentage. The chart shows the bars are not sorted by value; for example, 'Наличието на мафия' (11%) is followed by 'Ненаказуемостта на незаконните действия' (13%), but then 'Сложните и бавни административни процедури' (9%).
The description states that the horizontal axis has intervals of 5%. The gridlines on the chart indicate intervals of 2%, as there are 10 intervals to reach the 20% mark.

The description fails to list the data point for the category 'Недоброто законодателство' (Poor legislation), which has a value of 8%. The text purports to list all the remaining categories but omits this one.

errors.text_span: следван от „Неефективната съдебна система“ с 14%, „Ненаказуемостта на незаконните действия“ с 13%, „Стремежът към бързо забогатяване“ с 10% и „Наличието на мафия“ с 11%.
errors.evidence: The description lists several top reasons but does not present them in descending order of value, which can be confusing. It lists the 10% value before the 11% value ('...10% и „Наличието на мафия“ с 11%').

The description states that the meaning of the two colors (blue and red) is not clear, but it fails to mention the observable pattern that red bars correspond to values of 10% or higher, and blue bars correspond to values lower than 10%.
